name: levels: the Fibonacci ladder of the figure of figures (wf6/levels, run 2, 16 Oct 2026)

conventions.view: orthographic along d = -(1,1,1)/sqrt3, up u = (0,-1,1)/sqrt2, right r = (-2,1,1)/sqrt6
conventions.u: L/3 (a third of a block edge as drawn) = 0.272166
conventions.tones: a face is toned by the axis its normal is along: x grey #808080, y black, z white

leaf.what: the original drawing exactly: H = 1/9 (bar half-width, blocks), lengths hole 1, growth 2, side 3, tribar 5, outline 8 (in u)
leaf.size: one block (the game block, 1 m); the smallest leaf of a world is level 2

verified.note: the outline triangle (8 u) has its corners cut by the bar ends; horizontal extent 22/3 u

leaf.render_unit: woven unit at H=1/9 (wf1/design-nesting/weave_test.woven(1/9, slices)); 2.333% wrong vs cls (lattice floor 2.098%)

ladder.level_m_lengths_u: hole F(m), growth F(m+1), side F(m+2), tribar F(m+3), outline F(m+4)
ladder.corner_relation: a level-m frame holds three level-(m-1) frames centred at ab + sigma*(F(m+2)/3)*TRI_k, k = A, B, C (sigma = -1 in an inverted frame); their outlines are its tribar outlines, they overlap pairwise in triangles of side F(m+1) (less their cut corners, 9-10% short in area), their common opening is its hole F(m)
ladder.opening_relation: a level-m frame hole (side F(m)) is exactly the outline of a level-(m-4) frame, point-reflected (M = -I: on the lattice, tones by axis kept)
ladder.TRI_note: in block units for a level-2 frame (centroids of the corner tribars; |TRI_A - TRI_B| = L)
ladder.leaf_in_frame: a leaf in a level-m frame is the drawing scaled by s = F(m+4)/8, about CENTRE: p -> s M (p - CENTRE) + c + depth(1,1,1), c = CENTRE + a r + b u

depth_tilt.rule: each corner step adds a tilt about the parent centre c_j: depth += kappa * ((a,b) - ab(c_j)) . v_k along (1,1,1) (never changes the drawing); v_k = unit vector from the joint where sibling k lies under to the joint where it lies over (A over B at AB, B over C at BC, C over A at CA: the drawing's own cyclic order)
depth_tilt.inverted_frames: v unchanged (the true point reflection of the order)

rule_D.weight: how many details a thing holds (a leaf weighs 1; a record weighs 1)
rule_D.record: every node with two or more parts has its own record, a leaf standing for the thing itself (its name, its picture)
steps: 1. One part: it fills its parent's frame (one frame answers for both).
2. Odd count of parts: the node's record goes into its frame's opening (level m-4, inverted): the figure's centre is the thing itself.
3. Even count: the record is one more part, so the corners always take an odd count.

4. The (odd) parts are joined three at a time, the three lightest first (ties: the node's own order); each join is a figure of three, heaviest at A (top), then B (bottom-right), C (bottom-left); the last join fills the frame. A join's own opening stays open.
5. Corner = one level down (F(m+3)/F(m+4) ~ 1/phi in length); opening = four levels down.
6. The root's level K is the least that makes the smallest leaf level 2 (every leaf at least one block, drawn as the drawing).
7. Same information -> same world: the result depends only on the parts, their weights and their order in the files.
rule_D.code: ladder.py: layout(root) with RECORDS = True; Fr.corner, Fr.opening, Fr.copy (3D placement)

a_thirds_vs_golden.fibonacci_check: lengths hole 1-6H, growth 6H, side 1, tribar 1+6H, figure 2+6H (L): each the sum of the two before for any H; geometric in phi iff 36H^2+6H-1=0 iff 6H=1/phi; at H=1/9 = 1,2,3,5,8 thirds. 6H=2/3 is the 3rd convergent of 1/phi.
a_thirds_vs_golden.choice: the drawing's own thirds at the leaf, Fibonacci between levels (the golden ratio in integers, exact in every relation; converging to phi). Rejected: the golden bar 6H=1/phi (3.9 points further from the original, holes 15% wider in side, irrational lengths off the block grid); the drawing with exactly phi between scales (phi^-4 copies overflow its holes by 16.7%, phi^-1 corner copies fall 1.1% short of its tribar outlines).

b_holding_copies.corners: three level-(m-1) copies at the corners: outlines = the tribars; joints layered cyclically (A over B over C over A) by the tilt kappa = 1/(3L)
b_holding_copies.openings_summary: opening copies: 0 px outside the hole, 0 px over any corner leaf, the hole covered but its three corners (2.1%: the copy's own cut corners)
b_holding_copies.along_bars: no copy fits a bar: a copy's height over the bar width is 2.43, 1.5, 0.93 at phi^-2..-4 (q_b ALONG): copies go at corners and in openings, not along bars
b_holding_copies.closure_summary: drawing view 0 at every level; turned ortho gap/own size identical at every level (0.151 at 5 deg, 0.595 at 20, 1.259 at 45); the whole nest drawn in toward one eye (one projective map) closes exactly at every level, and opens together when the eye moves

c_how_many.per_frame: 3 corners + 1 opening (the record); by joins any count: n odd parts take (n-1)/2 joins, depth ~ log3 n
c_how_many.closing: the game closes a facade into its mean between bar 8 px and 4 px (a factor 2 = phi^1.44): about 1.44 levels are in transition at any distance; moving phi nearer reveals one level

d_level_units.every_level_unit: the same figure: a leaf is the drawing; a node is a figure of three (its parts' figures) round its opening (its own record)
d_level_units.scale: set by weight, not by kind: a thing holding w of its parent's W details sits ~log_phi(W/w)/2 levels below it
d_level_units.toy_uniform: planet 8 (outline F12=144 u = 18 blocks), city 7, place 6, work 5, details 3-4, records 2-4
